edbDesc: The physical phenomenon of a decrease in length detected by an observer of objects that travel at any non-zero velocity relative to that observer. This contraction is usually only noticeable at a substantial fraction of the speed of light; the contraction is only in the direction parallel to the direction in which the observed body is travelling.
title: Length Contraction
pickWhy: The deck has the FitzGerald contraction card (and special relativity).
